name: Kachufool
summary: Indian variant of Oh Hell trick-taking game where players bid exact tricks to score 10 plus bid.
rules_text: Play a series of rounds with increasing hand size. Total rounds is floor(52 / player_count). Each round has a fixed trump suit cycling Spades, Diamonds, Clubs, Hearts. Deal N cards where N = round number. Bidding phase: starting left of dealer each player bids number of tricks they will take; the last bidder may not bid a number that makes the sum of bids equal N. Alternative bid is simultaneous fingers. With >5 players a player may not bid zero six times in a row. Then play tricks clockwise from left of dealer following suit if possible, trump wins, otherwise highest lead suit. After N tricks score: if bid equals tricks taken, player scores 10 + bid (zero also scores 10). Otherwise scores 0.
rating_reason: Oh hell variant Kachufool, bidding forecasting, strategic trick-taking.
